app_fee.value: The Arts & Sciences application fee is $50, and it is not refunded.

toefl_min.value: Arts & Sciences sets a TOEFL iBT composite of 94 (old scale).

also.quote: Our graduate program follows the College of Arts and Sciences English Language Proficiency Policy.

ielts_min.value: Arts & Sciences sets an IELTS overall band of 6.5.

deadline.value: Full consideration for Fall admission is January 15; later applications may be considered if space and funding remain.
deadline.quote: The Physics Department’s full-consideration deadline for Fall admission is January 15 of each year

gre_general.value: The GRE General Test is optional for the physics PhD, though the department encourages it.
gre_general.quote: The GRE General Test and the Physics GRE Subject Test are optional; neither is required for admission to the Physics MS or PhD programs

gre_subject.value: The Physics GRE Subject Test is optional and not required for admission.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE General Test and the Physics GRE Subject Test are optional; neither is required for admission to the Physics MS or PhD programs

supervisor.value: Students are admitted to the PhD generally and pair with advisors after their first two semesters.
supervisor.quote: Students admitted to our PhD program are not expected to immediately work with a specific advisor

also.quote: After the first two semesters of classes, students are paired with temporary advisors

funding.value: Every admitted PhD student gets TA, RA or fellowship support, and tuition for coursework is covered.
funding.quote: All students admitted to the physics PhD program are supported financially

also.quote: the tuition for their coursework will also be covered

entry_route.value: Applicants with a bachelor's degree can apply straight to the PhD and earn an MS along the way.
entry_route.quote: Students who have a bachelor’s degree can apply directly to the Lehigh PhD program

notes: College of Arts & Sciences program. The physics page says it follows the Arts & Sciences English policy.
